name: 维拉-罗伯斯

points.title: 早期音乐启蒙
points.description: 维拉-罗伯斯出生于里约热内卢的一个中产阶级家庭，父亲是图书馆管理员和业余音乐家。他从小接触音乐，12岁时父亲去世后，他开始自学多种乐器，包括大提琴、吉他和单簧管。这段时期他主要靠自学和街头表演为生，没有接受正规的音乐教育，这种非传统的学习方式深刻影响了他后来的创作风格，使他能够融合巴西民间音乐与欧洲古典音乐传统。
points.descriptionEn: Villa-Lobos was born in Rio de Janeiro to a middle-class family; his father was a librarian and amateur musician. After his father's death when he was 12, he began teaching himself various instruments including cello, guitar, and clarinet. During this period, he supported himself through self-study and street performances, without formal musical education. This unconventional learning approach profoundly influenced his later compositional style, enabling him to blend Brazilian folk music with European classical traditions.

points.title: 民间音乐采集
points.description: 维拉-罗伯斯开始游历巴西内地，深入亚马逊雨林和巴西东北部地区，收集民间音乐素材。这段旅程中，他记录了大量巴西原住民和非洲裔巴西人的音乐传统，包括歌曲、节奏和乐器使用方法。这些民间音乐元素成为他日后创作的核心源泉。他特别关注巴西民间音乐中的复调技巧和即兴元素，这些特点后来融入了他的交响乐、室内乐和吉他作品中，形成了独特的'巴西主义'音乐风格。
points.descriptionEn: Villa-Lobos began traveling through Brazil's interior,深入 the Amazon rainforest and northeastern regions to collect folk music materials. During this journey, he recorded extensive musical traditions of Brazil's indigenous and Afro-Brazilian populations, including songs, rhythms, and instrumental techniques. These folk elements became the core source of his later compositions. He particularly focused on polyphonic techniques and improvisational elements in Brazilian folk music, which were later integrated into his symphonies, chamber music, and guitar works, forming a unique 'Brazilianist' musical style.

points.title: 欧洲艺术影响
points.description: 维拉-罗伯斯前往巴黎，这是他艺术生涯的重要转折点。在巴黎，他接触到了当时最前沿的现代音乐流派，包括印象派、表现主义和新古典主义。他结识了萨蒂、斯特拉文斯基和米约等重要作曲家，他们的创作理念对维拉-罗伯斯产生了深远影响。同时，他也在巴黎举办了多场音乐会，演奏自己的作品，开始获得国际声誉。这一时期他创作了《巴西的巴赫风格》系列作品，将巴西民间音乐与巴赫的对位技巧相结合，展现了他独特的音乐语言。
points.descriptionEn: Villa-Lobos traveled to Paris, a significant turning point in his artistic career. In Paris, he encountered the most avant-garde musical movements of the time, including Impressionism, Expressionism, and Neoclassicism. He met important composers such as Satie, Stravinsky, and Milhaud, whose ideas profoundly influenced him. He also performed his works in numerous concerts, beginning to gain international recognition. During this period, he composed his 'Bachianas Brasileiras' series, combining Brazilian folk music with Bach's contrapuntal techniques, showcasing his unique musical language.

points.title: 民族音乐教育
points.description: 返回巴西后，维拉-罗伯斯被任命为巴西教育部音乐顾问，开始了他大规模的音乐教育改革。他创建了巴西第一个全国性的音乐教育体系，将民间音乐纳入正规教育课程。他组织了'儿童合唱团'项目，让巴西儿童学习演唱传统歌曲。这一时期他创作了大量教育性作品，包括《吉他练习曲》和《钢琴小品集》。同时，他继续创作大型交响作品，包括14部交响曲和11部歌剧，这些作品融合了巴西民族元素与欧洲古典形式，奠定了他在巴西音乐史上的地位。
points.descriptionEn: Returning to Brazil, Villa-Lobos was appointed Music Advisor to the Ministry of Education, beginning large-scale music education reform. He created Brazil's first national music education system, incorporating folk music into formal curricula. He organized the 'Children's Choirs' project, teaching Brazilian children traditional songs. During this period, he composed numerous educational works including 'Guitar Studies' and 'Piano Miniatures'. He continued creating large-scale symphonic works, including 14 symphonies and 11 operas, which blended Brazilian national elements with European classical forms, establishing his position in Brazilian music history.

points.title: 国际声誉巅峰
points.description: 二战后，维拉-罗伯斯获得了国际声誉，成为巴西文化的重要象征。他频繁前往欧洲和美国演出，指挥自己的作品。1944年，他的《第五交响曲》在纽约首演获得巨大成功。这一时期他创作了《吉他协奏曲》和《单簧管协奏曲》等重要作品。1950年代，他创立了巴西音乐学院，培养了一代巴西作曲家。1957年，他获得联合国教科文组织颁发的国际音乐奖，成为巴西第一位获得国际认可的音乐家。他的作品被世界各大乐团演奏，成为20世纪音乐的重要组成部分。
points.descriptionEn: After World War II, Villa-Lobos gained international recognition, becoming an important symbol of Brazilian culture. He frequently toured Europe and the US, conducting his own works. In 1944, his Fifth Symphony premiered in New York to great acclaim. During this period, he composed important works including the 'Guitar Concerto' and 'Clarinet Concerto'. In the 1950s, he founded the Brazilian Conservatory of Music, training a generation of Brazilian composers. In 1957, he received the International Music Award from UNESCO, becoming Brazil's first internationally recognized musician. His works were performed by major orchestras worldwide, becoming an essential part of 20th-century music.

supporter.zh: 维拉-罗伯斯被誉为巴西音乐的民族英雄，他将巴西丰富的民间音乐传统提升到世界级艺术高度。他的作品融合了巴西原住民、非洲裔和欧洲移民的音乐元素，创造出独特的'巴西主义'风格，为巴西音乐赢得了国际声誉。作为音乐教育家，他改革了巴西的音乐教育体系，使民间音乐成为正规教育的一部分，培养了新一代巴西音乐人才。他的音乐不仅保存了巴西文化遗产，还向世界展示了巴西音乐的独特魅力。
supporter.en: Villa-Lobos is celebrated as a national hero of Brazilian music, elevating the country's rich folk traditions to world-class artistic heights. His works blended indigenous African, and European immigrant musical elements, creating a unique 'Brazilianist' style that earned international recognition for Brazilian music. As a music educator, he revolutionized Brazil's music education system, incorporating folk music into formal curricula and training a new generation of Brazilian musicians. His music not only preserved Brazil's cultural heritage but also showcased the unique charm of Brazilian music to the world.

critic.zh: 批评者认为维拉-罗伯斯对民间音乐的采集和改编存在过度简化和刻板印象的问题，有时将复杂的民间传统简化为异国情调的元素。他的音乐教育改革也被批评为过于理想化，忽视了巴西社会不平等的现实。此外，一些评论家指出他的作品结构上有时显得松散，缺乏严谨的作曲技巧，特别是在大型交响作品中。他的国际成功也被部分人视为迎合西方对'异国情调'的刻板印象，而非真正创新的艺术成就。
critic.en: Critics argue that Villa-Lobos' collection and adaptation of folk music involved oversimplification and stereotyping, sometimes reducing complex traditions to exotic elements. His music education reforms were criticized as overly idealistic, ignoring Brazil's social inequalities. Additionally, some commentators note his works can structurally seem loose, lacking rigorous compositional techniques, particularly in large symphonic pieces. His international success was also seen by some as catering to Western stereotypes of the 'exotic' rather than representing genuine artistic innovation.

objective.zh: 从历史和文化角度看，维拉-罗伯斯是20世纪最重要的民族主义作曲家之一，他成功地将巴西民间音乐元素融入西方古典音乐传统，创造了独特的音乐语言。在流行文化中，他的作品已成为巴西国家身份的象征，经常在重大国际场合演奏。他的《巴西的巴赫风格》系列作品成为连接东西方音乐传统的桥梁，影响了后来的世界音乐发展。尽管存在争议，但维拉-罗伯斯无疑重塑了巴西音乐的国际形象，使巴西音乐从边缘走向世界音乐舞台的中心。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Villa-Lobos stands as one of the most important nationalist composers of the 20th century, successfully integrating Brazilian folk elements into Western classical traditions to create a unique musical language. In popular culture, his works have become symbols of Brazilian national identity, frequently performed at major international events. His 'Bachianas Brasileiras' series bridges Eastern and Western musical traditions, influencing later world music developments. Despite controversies, Villa-Lobos undoubtedly reshaped Brazil's international musical image, moving Brazilian music from the periphery to the center of the world music stage.

self.zh: 音乐是宇宙的语言，它超越一切国界和种族。
self.en: Music is the language of the universe, it transcends all borders and races.

others.zh: 维拉-罗伯斯是巴西音乐的灵魂，他让世界听到了巴西的心跳。
others.en: Villa-Lobos is the soul of Brazilian music, he let the world hear the heartbeat of Brazil.
